tflspec: Excel specifications for tables, listings and figures

Source: R/tflspec-package.R
tflspec-package.Rd

Reads study specifications written in Excel and turns them into what a clinical TFL report is made of: ARD-based tables (ard_*(), table_plan() / plan_*(), tfl_table_spec() / tfl_read_report_spec()) and figure code (tfl_fig_spec() / tfl_fig_code()). Rendering to RTF is rtfreporter's job; this package decides what goes on the page.
